plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 5-date timeline completes: 1906 (Richard Dixon Oldham identifies P-waves, S-waves, and a central Earth core) · 8 Oct 1909 (Andrija Mohorovičić discovers the 35 km crust-mantle Moho discontinuity after the Pokupsko earthquake near Zagreb) · 1914–1926 (Beno Gutenberg maps the 2,890 km core-mantle boundary and 104°–140° shadow zone; Harold Jeffreys proves the outer core is liquid) · 17 Jun 1929–1936 (Inge Lehmann uses New Zealand earthquake traces in the shadow zone to discover the 1,220 km-radius inner core in her paper 'P'') · 1940–1971 (Francis Birch and normal-mode oscillations prove 3.6 million atmospheres of pressure compress the 5,400 °C inner core into solid iron-nickel).
